provenance: Telephone call, 2026-09-01, Larry's son asking the four cold interview probes written the same day and typing Larry's answers as he spoke them. Nothing from the day's document research was supplied to him before he answered. Raw capture and analysis: research/interviews/2026-09-01-phone-answers.md.
text: Body Jab 42, Right Cross, Upper Cut, Might have been a Body Jab 41, 43, Major Schartkoff was in charge of them.
researchNotes: Asked open whether he remembered other call signs on that net, with none supplied. On 2026-08-23 this archive wrote that his boxing-terms rule predicted siblings — "hook, uppercut, southpaw, counter, clinch" — for related stations (research/units/callsigns-and-units.md). He produced Upper Cut and Right Cross cold, and a numbering series 41/42/43 that supports the standing hypothesis that the digits mark the station within a net rather than belonging to the call word. Format difference recorded and not corrected: a period memoir found the same day gives the Đồng Xoài camp radio as "55 Body Jab", number first, against his "Body Jab 42", number last. "Schartkoff" is his own spelling.
